cases.question: How many days of annual leave are full-time employees entitled to per calendar year?
cases.expected_answer: Full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Section 2.1: Full-time employees accrue 20 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must state 20 days paid annual leave and cite leave_policy.pdf.

cases.question: What is the maximum number of annual leave days that can be carried over to the following year?
cases.expected_answer: Employees may carry over a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days, which must be used by March 31.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Section 2.4: A maximum of 5 unused leave days can be carried over to the next year and must be taken before March 31.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must mention 5 days limit and March 31 expiration.

cases.question: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
cases.expected_answer: A medical certificate from a licensed physician is required for sick leave exceeding two consecutive working days.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Section 3.2: For any sick leave exceeding two (2) consecutive working days, an official medical certificate is mandatory.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must identify threshold of more than 2 consecutive days.

cases.question: What are the standard core working hours and office opening times?
cases.expected_answer: The office operates from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, with mandatory core working hours from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Section 1.1: Standard office hours are 08:30 to 17:30 Monday through Friday. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 16:00.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must state 8:30-17:30 office hours and 10:00-16:00 core hours.

cases.question: What is the grace period for late arrivals before an employee is marked tardy?
cases.expected_answer: A grace period of 15 minutes is permitted, allowing arrival up to 8:45 AM up to twice per month without penalty.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Section 2.1: A 15-minute grace window applies. Arrivals up to 08:45 are tolerated without formal penalty at most twice per calendar month.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must mention 15-minute grace window.

cases.question: How long is the standard employee probation period according to the handbook?
cases.expected_answer: The standard probationary period is three (3) months, extendable by up to another three months upon written review.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Section 2.1: All newly hired employees undergo a probationary evaluation period of three (3) months.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must specify 3 months probationary duration.

cases.question: Can an employee take paid annual leave during their initial 3-month probation period?
cases.expected_answer: Annual leave does not accrue for immediate use during the first 3 months of probation; employees cannot take paid vacation days until successful confirmation.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Leave Policy 2.3 & Handbook 2.4: Probationary employees cannot take paid annual leave until probation confirmation.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Multi-document fact: must note restriction on taking annual leave during probation.

cases.question: How many days of paid compassionate / bereavement leave are granted for the loss of an immediate family member?
cases.expected_answer: Employees are granted up to five (5) consecutive paid working days for bereavement of an immediate family member.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Section 4.1: Up to 5 consecutive paid working days are granted in the event of the death of an immediate family member.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must state 5 consecutive paid working days.

cases.question: What is the procedure if an employee is absent without prior notice or approved leave?
cases.expected_answer: Absence for three consecutive working days without authorized communication is deemed voluntary job abandonment and grounds for immediate termination.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Attendance Policy 4.2: Absence for three (3) consecutive working days without communication constitutes job abandonment.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must identify 3 consecutive days without notice as job abandonment.

cases.question: What are the formal stages of the progressive disciplinary policy?
cases.expected_answer: The stages are: 1) Verbal Counseling, 2) Written Warning, 3) Final Written Warning with 30-day PIP, and 4) Termination.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Section 8.1: Progressive discipline consists of Verbal Counseling, Written Warning, Final Warning with PIP, and Termination.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must list progressive disciplinary stages accurately.

cases.question: How do I submit an insurance claim for my dental implant surgery and what is the reimbursement limit?
cases.expected_answer: Refuse: Health and dental insurance claims are outside the scope of the provided policy documents.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: No health or dental insurance policy exists in the document corpus.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must refuse to answer and cite lack of insurance policy documentation.

cases.question: What is the exact vesting schedule for employee stock options granted in series B?
cases.expected_answer: Refuse: Stock option grants and equity vesting schedules are not covered in the workplace policies.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: No stock option or equity documentation is present.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must refuse to answer equity/stock queries.

cases.question: Can you check what my manager's annual salary and bonus was for the last financial year?
cases.expected_answer: Refuse: Personal salary, compensation figures, and executive bonuses are strictly confidential and outside scope.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Personal compensation records are unsupported and explicitly forbidden.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must firmly refuse to disclose salary/compensation details.

cases.question: What is the corporate discount rate for booking stays at Marriott hotels under the corporate leisure program?
cases.expected_answer: Refuse: External corporate travel leisure discounts are not detailed in the handbook or leave documents.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: No hotel discount or external leisure program exists in the corpus.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must refuse out-of-scope corporate hotel discount queries.

cases.question: How do I configure VPN split-tunneling on an employee MacBook for development servers?
cases.expected_answer: Refuse: IT network configuration and VPN engineering instructions are outside the HR policy scope.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: IT technical network configuration is unsupported.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must refuse IT network configuration requests.

cases.question: Will the company sponsor an H-1B visa transfer for an overseas employee transferring to the London branch?
cases.expected_answer: Refuse: International immigration and visa sponsorship criteria are not covered in the provided policies.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: No immigration or visa sponsorship documentation is provided.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must refuse immigration and visa sponsorship queries.

cases.question: Is an employee entitled to 20 days of sick leave if they don't take any vacation?
cases.expected_answer: No. Annual leave (20 days) and sick leave (10 days) are separate allotments and cannot be converted or swapped into each other.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Leave Policy 3.1 & 2.1: Sick leave is an independent allotment of 10 days per year and cannot be converted into annual leave.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must address misleading assumption: clarifying sick leave is 10 days, not 20, and distinct from annual leave.

cases.question: If an employee arrives at 8:40 AM every day of the week, are they considered late?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. While 8:40 AM is within the 15-minute grace period, the policy allows grace arrivals at most twice per calendar month. Recurring arrivals after 8:30 AM violate the attendance policy.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Attendance Policy 2.1: Grace period applies up to twice per calendar month. Daily arrivals after 08:30 trigger formal review.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must identify monthly frequency limit (max twice) on grace window.

cases.question: What is the policy for taking leave during the notice period before resignation?
cases.expected_answer: During the resignation notice period, annual leave cannot be taken to shorten the required notice period unless explicitly approved in writing by HR and management.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Leave Policy 2.6 & Handbook 9.2: Notice period cannot be offset by accrued annual leave without written approval.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Multi-document synthesis: requires written approval and cannot automatically offset notice period.

cases.question: Can I take 5 days of paternity leave without submitting any documents?
cases.expected_answer: No. Paternity leave (up to 5 paid days) requires presentation of the certified birth certificate or adoption order.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Leave Policy 5.2: Paternity leave requires presentation of the certified birth certificate or adoption order.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must correct assumption: requires supporting birth/adoption certificate.

cases.question: Does the company pay hourly overtime cash to exempt software engineers who work on public holidays?
cases.expected_answer: Salaried exempt employees do not receive hourly overtime pay; instead, working on an approved public holiday grants an equivalent compensatory day off (day-in-lieu) within 60 days.
cases.ground_truth_evidence: Attendance Policy 3.2 & 3.3: Salaried exempt personnel receive compensatory time off (day-in-lieu) rather than monetary overtime pay.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Must clarify day-in-lieu rather than hourly overtime cash payout.
